decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component improvement to the firm's core infrared heater line, so it costs little to carry, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations in a growing industry there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The plaque heater had its own page in 2019, which signals a central position in the narrow core portfolio, and industry growth suggests results meet aspirations.
The luminous radiant heater sits firmly within the established gas infrared business, and with no sign of underperformance against aspirations the firm has no reason to drop it.
A multi-model tube heater line is a core revenue product for hall heating and fits the energy-efficiency and regulatory demand in a growing market, so keeping it is satisfactory.
The standard plaque heater was presented on its own page and serves as a base product of the core offer, so its results likely meet aspirations and justify keeping it.
This tube heater may overlap with line D and could be consolidated, but in the absence of signs of a performance shortfall the firm is likely to keep it.
